title: Tunisian Quenched Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish made with tunisian spices, quenched eggs, and a hint of ackee, cooked to perfection in a rich tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat the tagine sauce in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the tunisian spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the quenched eggs and cook until set.
Add the ackee and cook until heated through.
Stir in the fermented olives and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
